summary: End-to-end testing of the Manufacturer's Distributor Intelligence Center (frontend rewrite + backend fat endpoint). Backend pytest: 14/14 pass against the live preview URL. Frontend smoke (1920x800) on demo distributor SUARA & CO. and the empty-state distributor: 26/26 required data-testids present, 5 AI insights rendered, semi-circle gauge shows 31/100 'Critical' (within the 25-30 spec window), search filter / health filter / CSV export / coverage sort / Edit Distributor dialog / back-button navigation all functional, zero console errors, empty-state distributor renders Retail Revenue ₦0 cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: ManufacturerDistributorDetail.jsx is ~1055 lines — split into /components/distributor-intel/ subfiles (KPIStrip, AIBriefHero, NetworkHealthGauge, RetailPerformanceMatrix, RetailCoverageMap, TopRetailers, ProductPenetration, AttentionList, RetailerIntelligenceTable). Hot-reload + future tests will benefit; the file is well past the 700-line guideline.

distributor_intelligence.py product_penetration loop fires one db.daily_sales.find() per product (N+1). At 10 products it's fine, but at 100+ SKUs per manufacturer this will degrade. Pre-aggregate revenue/units by product_id in the same 180d scan and look it up, rather than re-querying.

Synthetic sparkline arrays for active_retailers, network_health_score, stockout_risk_retailers, avg_sell_through, retail_order_frequency are deterministic functions of the current value (e.g., `active_retailers - 2 + i // 4`). They look real but carry no information — either persist a daily snapshot collection or mark them null. Same demo-data caveat called out for product_intelligence in iter 7.

AI insight #1 ('Retail sales increased 100.0% this period.') is a div-by-zero artefact: when prev_90d revenue == 0 _delta_pct returns a hard-coded 100.0. With 180 days of seed data this means the prior 90-day window has no sales, so growth is meaningless. Consider returning null and rendering 'N/A' on the UI when the prior window is empty.

sell_through_pct is a synthetic proxy `units_90 / (units_90 + 200) * 100` (line 153). At ~50 retailers in the demo distributor this yields a fairly compressed range; document it or replace with a real stock-vs-sales ratio so the KPI is defensible.

Back button uses navigate(-1); if a user opens the URL directly the back stack falls through to the dashboard (observed behaviour). Consider navigate('/distributors') as a safe fallback when history.length <= 1.
BCG matrix anti-overlap loop runs O(N^2 * 80) on the client every render. For >200 retailers the first render will jank — memoise the placement or run inside a Web Worker / one-shot useEffect.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on critical paths (26/26 testids, 5 AI insights, search+filter+export+dialog+nav all green, no console errors, empty-state OK)
